title: filter_properties takes &[String] forcing callers to deref — should take &[impl AsRef<str>]
description: email.rs:536, snippet.rs uses filter_properties — fn filter_properties(obj: &Value, properties: &[String]) copies string slices from the properties argument. The function only needs to compare strings, not own them. The parameter should be &[impl AsRef<str>] or &[&str] to avoid forcing callers to maintain a Vec<String> instead of a Vec<&str> or an array of string literals. Low-impact now but establishes a better pattern.
